AMD FidelityFX SDK, https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK
Revision d7531ae47d8b36a5d4025663e731a47a38be882f (SDK 1.0), LICENSE.txt. SGL3D
ports the Single Pass Downsampler v2.1 (sdk/include/FidelityFX/gpu/spd/ffx_spd.h,
SpdDownsample), as Bevy 9d12036 ports it in
crates/bevy_core_pipeline/src/mip_generation/experimental/downsample_depth.wesl,
into stages/cull/pyramid.wgsl.

AMD FidelityFX Denoiser, https://github.com/GPUOpen-Effects/FidelityFX-Denoiser
Revision d7dfecbabe7b9523b14e7b067216e06b86e8d189, LICENSE.txt. The DiligentFX
port adds the reflection hit reprojection and surface-reprojection discard of
ffx-reflection-dnsr/ffx_denoiser_reflections_reproject.h to
SSR_ComputeSpatialReconstruction.wgsl and SSR_ComputeTemporalAccumulation.wgsl
(PROVENANCE.md DFX-25).

Revision 92a29e701a6b0bf8846484c3999c2ba97d90dd06, LICENSE-MIT (Bevy is dual

Filament, https://github.com/google/filament
Revision ef1a133d6777299ad971a0f9612adf4aad281f46, LICENSE (Apache-2.0). SGL3D ports normalFiltering
(shaders/src/surface_shading_lit.fs) and its material defaults into pbr.wgsl, and
SpecularAO_Lagarde and gtaoMultiBounce (shaders/src/surface_ambient_occlusion.fs)
with their desktop defaults into specular_lobes.wgsl, and AgxToneMapper
(filament/src/ToneMapper.cpp) with the sRGB and Rec. 2020 conversions
(filament/src/ColorSpaceUtils.h) into tone_map.wgsl.

Godot Engine, https://github.com/godotengine/godot
Revision ed1daf0bf001b61586d9930840f2f1394092c079 (4.7.2-stable), LICENSE.txt.

Godot Engine, https://github.com/godotengine/godot
Revision d851ae838de54a0bd3dde9043912f39c74265cdd, LICENSE.txt. The DiligentFX
port adds the depth-tolerance pass-through of
servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/effects/screen_space_reflection.glsl to
SSR_ComputeIntersection.wgsl (PROVENANCE.md DFX-18), and from revision
b13043816a0f234985030ec035363a005bc86c32 the motion-difference rejection,
speed-scaled variance box and history clip of
servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/effects/taa_resolve.glsl and

TAA_ComputeTemporalAccumulation.wgsl (DFX-14).

Spartan Engine, https://github.com/PanosK92/SpartanEngine
Revision a8338d0609b85dc32f3732a5c27fb4463816a3b9, LICENSE.txt. Godot's
servers/rendering/renderer_rd/shaders/effects/taa_resolve.glsl (revision
b13043816a0f234985030ec035363a005bc86c32) is based on Spartan Engine's TAA at
this revision and carries this notice; the DiligentFX port adds its
motion-difference rejection, speed-scaled variance box and history clip to
TAA_ComputeTemporalAccumulation.wgsl (PROVENANCE.md DFX-14).

Wicked Engine, https://github.com/turanszkij/WickedEngine
Revision 4323a33c94d021d45404adaf863e9b01673ab365, LICENSE.txt. SGL3D ports the
probe culling of WickedEngine/shaders/lightCullingCS.hlsl in probe_culling.wgsl,
and from revision 2ff1d9e7b36091d6edf9f823af77e6bc9af20e3b the RT reflection
trace and denoiser (rtreflectionCS.hlsl, ssr_resolveCS.hlsl, ssr_temporalCS.hlsl,
ssr_upsampleCS.hlsl, stochasticSSRHF.hlsli and brdf.hlsli in
WickedEngine/shaders/) in world_reflections*.wgsl and temporal_reprojection.wgsl,
through which Godot's screen-space reflections (godot_reflections_temporal.wgsl)
also accumulate; from revision df44c3db4c4927492bc9c791eac715d98d7ed091 its
dynamic diffuse GI (ddgi_rayallocationCS.hlsl, ddgi_indirectprepareCS.hlsl,
ddgi_raytraceCS.hlsl, ddgi_updateCS.hlsl, ShaderInterop_DDGI.h and the RNG
and octahedral helpers of globals.hlsli in WickedEngine/shaders/, and
wiRenderer.cpp's DDGI) in shading/dynamic_gi*.wgsl, shading/surface_ray.wgsl
and stages/dynamic_gi/, with the irradiance map of revision
95e357f73f28d24e70ce7a1ab8f9fb954de457e4 (ShaderInterop_DDGI.h and
ddgi_updateCS.hlsl).
